tips_en: Start with Simple-WAM (Paper 2) for its surprising finding that fully noised future video tokens in a single forward pass can replace iterative video denoising in World Action Models—this resolves a disputed efficiency-generalization trade-off and is the most paradigm-challenging contribution. It connects naturally to Paper 3 (PanoVLN), as both address embodied AI efficiency in real-world deployment, and to Paper 1 (MaLiang-Harness) through shared themes of video-based visual reasoning and program-guided generation pipelines.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读第二篇论文（Simple-WAM），因为它揭示了一个令人惊讶的发现：仅需对完全加噪的未来视频token做一次前向传播，即可替代World Action Model中迭代式的视频去噪过程——这化解了效率与泛化能力之间长期存在的争议，是最具颠覆性的贡献。该论文与第三篇（PanoVLN）都聚焦于具身智能在真实场景中的部署效率，与第一篇（MaLiang-Harness）在视频视觉推理和程序化生成流程上也有共通之处，便于形成连贯的阅读脉络。
